title: Maximum Number of Consecutive Values You Can Make
goal: Count consecutive constructible sums beginning at zero when each coin can be used once.
strategy: If all sums through reach are available, a coin at most reach+1 extends coverage through reach+coin. A larger coin leaves the first gap permanently uncovered.
